Proposition
[Lie algebra homomorphism]

Source: petersen:page-0081 ↗ def:pet-ch2-endomorphism-derivation

1. ch2:2.3.1The linear map $\mathrm{End}(V)\to \mathrm{End}(T(V))$, $L\mapsto LT$, is a Lie algebra homomorphism that preserves symmetries of tensors.
Proof

↗ def:pet-ch2-endomorphism-derivation

\sketch In $L_1(L_2T)-L_2(L_1T)$, terms in which the maps act on different tensor slots cancel in pairs. Terms acting twice on one slot combine to $(L_1L_2-L_2L_1)T$. Thus the induced map preserves brackets. It also commutes with permutations of tensor slots and therefore preserves tensor symmetries.

□
